title: Store Incharge
description:
Manage daily store and warehouse operations, including receiving, storing, issuing, and dispatching materials and spare parts.
   

 Maintain accurate inventory and stock records using SAP and Microsoft Excel.
   

 Receive incoming spare parts and materials, verify quantities, part numbers, and supporting documents.
   

 Maintain proper bin locations, stock identification, and material organization.
   

 Issue spare parts and materials to technicians, service teams, and departments as per approved requirements.
   

 Monitor minimum/maximum stock levels and coordinate timely replenishment of fast\-moving and critical spare parts.
   

 Conduct regular physical stock verification and cycle counts and reconcile discrepancies.
   

 Prepare and maintain GRN, material issue, transfer, return, and other store\-related documents.
   

 Handle billing, documentation, purchase\-related records, and material dispatch.
   

 Coordinate with purchase, service, accounts, suppliers, and internal departments for smooth material flow.
   

 Track obsolete, slow\-moving, damaged, and warranty\-return spare parts.
   

 Ensure proper housekeeping, safety, and 5S practices within the store.
   

 Support stock audits and inventory reconciliation and maintain required documentation.
   

 Ensure spare parts are available on time to support maintenance and service operations.
   

 Key Skills: SAP • Inventory Management • Spare Parts Management • Warehouse Operations • Stock Control • GRN \& Material Issue • MS Excel • Billing \& Documentation • Dispatch • Stock Auditing • Team Coordination
